```{r}
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(performance)
library(MASS)
library(pscl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(sjPlot)
library(webshot)
```

AMBIENT, WARM AND HOT LARVAL TEMPERATURE

```{r}
results <- read.csv(here("data", "clean data", "results.csv"), colClasses = c(sex = "character"))

#remove ambient, because these need to be modelled separately. also remove larval treatment of cool and mean, because the sample size isn't big enough to model - just not enough clutches.
#I think I will model the ambient larva treatment separately.
results_filtered <- results %>%
  filter(
    larval_treatment %in% c("ambient", "warm", "hot")) %>%
  mutate(weight_mg = weight * 1000) %>%
  mutate(weight_mg_centered = weight_mg - mean(weight_mg, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(
    c(weight_mg, egg_mean_1A, clutch_size),
    ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
    .names = "{.col}_z"
  ))


results_filtered <- results_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    larval_treatment = factor(larval_treatment, levels = c("ambient", "warm","hot")),
    pupal_treatment = factor(pupal_treatment, levels = c("ambient", "cool","mean","warm","hot"))
  )


```

```{r}
#look at the distribution of clutch size
ggplot(results, aes(x = clutch_size)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5) +  # change this value to control bin width +
  labs(title = "Distribution of clutch size",
       x = "clutch size",
       y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()


#mean and variance of clutch size
# mean
mean(results_filtered$clutch_size, na.rm = TRUE)

# variance
var(results_filtered$clutch_size, na.rm = TRUE)

#the mean is much greater than the variance, suggesting that a negative binomial model might be better than the poisson model

#testing whether poisson or negative binomial model is better

pois_mod <- glm(clutch_size ~ 1, family = poisson(link = "log"), data = results)

nb_mod <- glm.nb(clutch_size ~ 1, data = results)

AIC(pois_mod, nb_mod)
#the AIC is way, way lower for the negative binomial model, so this is the better model to use.




```


```{r}
#make the hurdle model
mod.hurdl_4 <- glmmTMB(clutch_size ~ larval_treatment + pupal_treatment + weight_mg_centered + (1 | grandmotherID), ziformula = ~ larval_treatment + pupal_treatment + weight_mg_centered, family = truncated_nbinom2, data = results_filtered)


# Dynamically extract random effects, group count, and dispersion from mod.hurdl_4
vc <- VarCorr(mod.hurdl_4)$cond$grandmotherID
re_var <- as.numeric(vc)
re_sd <- attr(vc, "stddev")
ngrps <- summary(mod.hurdl_4)$ngrps$cond["grandmotherID"]

re_note <- sprintf(
  "Random effects (Conditional): grandmotherID (Intercept) Variance = %.5f, SD = %.4f (Number of obs: %d, groups: grandmotherID, %d).",
  re_var, re_sd, nobs(mod.hurdl_4), ngrps
)

disp_note <- sprintf(
  "Dispersion parameter for truncated_nbinom2 family: %.2f.",
  sigma(mod.hurdl_4)
)

modelsummary(
  list(" " = mod.hurdl_4),
  effects = "fixed",
  estimate = "{estimate}{stars}",
  statistic = c(
    "Std. Error" = "{std.error}",
    "z value"    = "{statistic}",
    "Pr(>|z|)"   = "{p.value}"
  ),
  shape = component + term ~ model + statistic, # Keeps both 'cond' and 'zi' sections without duplicate errors
  fmt = 3,
  gof_map = NA,
  title = "Family: truncated_nbinom2 (log) | Formula: clutch_size ~ larval_treatment + pupal_treatment + weight_mg_centered + (1 | grandmotherID) | ZI: ~ larval_treatment + pupal_treatment + weight_mg_centered",
  notes = c(
    re_note,
    disp_note,
    "Signif. codes: *** p < 0.001, ** p < 0.01, * p < 0.05, . p < 0.1"
  ),
  output = here("mod_hurdl_4.docx")
)







summary(mod.hurdl_4)
AIC(mod.hurdl_4)
#2467

#print a nice model table to put in the appendix
tab_model(mod.hurdl_4,
          transform = NULL,   
          show.se = TRUE,   
          show.ci = FALSE) 

```


```{r}
#checking the assumptions of this model
library(DHARMa)

# simulate residuals
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(mod.hurdl_4)

# basic diagnostic plots
plot(sim_res)

testDispersion(sim_res)

testZeroInflation(sim_res)


#plot observed vs predicted
pred <- predict(mod.hurdl_4, type = "response")

plot(pred, results_filtered$clutch_size)
abline(0, 1, col = "red")
```
